title: feat(db): the wave 5 db truth — the oslabels table, the component strings and the seed cleanup
body: The owner's db law lands in both directions. Out of the components: a new typed label table devthink/oslabels.ts (836 rows following the chatlabels grammar — typed ids, exact copy, the osText accessor) now owns every user-visible string of the os shell and app surfaces (the shell chrome, the start menu, the tray, the alt switcher, the panel and window frames, the app surfaces audio through usage), and forty-plus components read through the accessors with byte-identical renders — the chat surface keeps chatlabels.ts and the settings and auth surfaces keep copy.ts, the ownership doctrine recorded in the table header. Out of the database: the hardcoded junk the seed catalog carried leaves (322 lines of stale demo rows), the schemas and accessors stay, and every consumer of a removed row handles its absence gracefully.
